pr_title: Graduate Volume Expansion to Beta + e2e tests
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**

/kind feature

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

Move volume expansion support to beta and enable e2e tests.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Fixes #81166

```release-note
Move CSI volume expansion to beta.
```

**Additional documentation e.g., KEPs (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals), usage docs, etc.**:


issue_context.body: We need to make sure that all the tests are enabled and make sure that we test more than just mock CSI volume plugin.
